p: If healthy, Young will be given some role in the offense, but no specific workload was promised.
Taylor praised his physical play but gave no usage commitment, so he is only a stash or watch candidate.
Just keep keep carving roles for everybody.
Will get back involved and can reassume the role he had before his injury, helping fill the gap left by Tanner Hudson.
A healthy Young could take back snaps and targets as an offensive depth piece, especially with Hudson out.
He's looked as good as he's looked in a long time.
